angularDiameterSource: Limb-darkened angular diameter 0.450 +/- 0.006 mas from the CHARA Array, Elliott et al. (2024, PASA 41, e056; arXiv:2401.01468), abstract; at the Gaia DR3 distance it is the radius of the astronomy record, 1,006,594 km.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 source 3205095125321700480: parallax 33.4390 +/- 0.0777 mas (RUWE 1.15), inverted to 29.9052 pc with no zero-point correction.
radiusSource: Radius: the CHARA Array limb-darkened angular diameter 0.450 +/- 0.006 mas of Elliott et al. (2024, PASA 41, e056; arXiv:2401.01468) at the Gaia DR3 distance 29.9052 pc: 1,006,594 km, 1.4469 solar radii at 695700 km per solar radius (Elliott et al. give 1.45 +/- 0.02 solar radii with the zero-point corrected parallax). GM from their PARSEC isochrone mass 1.550 +0.006/-0.005 solar masses times the JPL solar GM 132712440041.93938 km^3/s^2. presentationUp: the display axis (celestial north at the star) is up; the star's spin axis has no measured direction on the sky.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Elliott et al. (2024, PASA 41, e056; arXiv:2401.01468): effective temperature 7422 +/- 58 K from the CHARA limb-darkened diameter, bolometric flux and parallax, https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.01468
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the PARSEC isochrone mass 1.550 solar masses of Elliott et al. (2024, PASA 41, e056) and the package radius 1,006,594 km, log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.31 (Rajan et al. 2017 fit 3.95 +/- 0.04 from the spectral energy distribution).
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of 51 Eri (pscomppars): spectral type F0 IV, from Macintosh et al. 2015 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015Sci...350...64M/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of 51 Eri (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.13 dex, from Elliott et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024PASA...41...43E/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of 51 Eri (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.7574, from Elliott et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024PASA...41...43E/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of 51 Eri (pscomppars): age 0.0232 Gyr, from Elliott et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024PASA...41...43E/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: VizieR J/AJ/165/164/table2 (Tull RVels, rotation periods and Inclinations), column Prot: 0.9 d, the row 0.0 arcsec from the star's J2000 place

rotationPeriodsCatalogued.source: VizieR J/AJ/165/164/table2 (Tull RVels, rotation periods and Inclinations), column Prot: 0.9 d, the row 0.0 arcsec from the star's J2000 place

projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of 51 Eri (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 65.19 km/s, from Swastik et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....161..114S/abstract)
spinInclinationSource: Computed here from this record's rotation period, projected rotation speed and radius (1.447 solar radii): sin i = v sin i × P / (2πR) = 0.801. Not a measurement of the axis: the three numbers come from different papers.

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius in the shared neutral gray; the photosphere of a giant star is not a solid surface and its limb is not sharp.
